result.title: TIMERSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
result.summary: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real- world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and re- curring forecast errors unaddressed, while tai- lored pipelines require substantial human ex- pertise and effort. We introduce TIMERSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A cod- ing agent translates task descriptions into ex- ecutable pipeline changes. It tests each re- vision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent re- visions. During deployment, an adaptive se- lector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar con- ditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and FEV- bench, TIMERSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting met- rics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models.

AI.brief_summary: TIMERSI 面向冻结的时序基础模型，构建自改进的 agent 化部署系统：由编码 agent 把任务描述转成可执行的 pipeline 改动，在历史预测窗口上测试并用观测误差指导后续修订，部署时再由自适应选择器在相近条件下挑选管线，并在 TIME、FEV-bench 的 198 个任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作虽属时序领域，但其「用已完成轨迹的误差反馈迭代修正」与「相似条件下从多条候选管线中选择」的机制，可能为 LVR 的轨迹级监督、贡献分配以及动态计算与停止决策的评价提供问题表述上的启发，迁移性需人工核查。
